optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample documents establish the candidate’s experience in forecasting, planning, incident reduction, approval tracking, and assumptions documentation for the Capacity Planning Analyst role. They do not provide evidence of production‑level deployment, ownership beyond collaboration, or metrics beyond the incident counts cited.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Capacity Planning Analyst role.

role.roleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Enterprise Knowledge Base

evidence.text: Kept the per-customer load model that predicts search queries and sync volume from user counts and document growth; every month I recalibrated it against the platform metrics warehouse.
Turned each quarter's forecast into an index-shard and storage plan that the platform team and I took to the quarterly planning meeting.

Capacity-related incidents fell from 7 in the first half of the year to 2 in the second half after the shard rebalancing plan was applied, as counted in the platform incident register against its published baseline of 7 incidents per half-year.

Took capacity changes through the quarterly planning meeting with the platform and customer teams; the platform lead approved shard changes and the customer teams handled communication with their accounts.
Kept an assumptions note per cycle covering the model inputs, the fact that bulk document imports sat outside the forecast, and what the next cycle inherited.
